title: Red Hat Security Advisory: ruby:4.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple integer overflow vulnerabilities have been identified in the Ruby 4.0 regular expression compiler, including one affecting CI/CD pipelines. These issues could lead to unexpected behavior or potential security risks when processing regular expressions. Red Hat has released an update for Ruby 4.0 in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 to address these vulnerabilities along with other bug fixes and enhancements.
